response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(sa.station_avg) AS mean_station_bandwidth_usage, AVG(sa.station_avg - b.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_averages sa CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.overall_avg;
